import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-staggered-bottleneck/tools'))
import seal_case as seal
batch=root/'tmp/staggered_bottleneck/20261103_midflow_V1_screen73_12'
stage=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/projected_predecessor_v1_screen73_12'
archive=stage/'evidence_complete12.tar.gz'
proof=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete12.tar.verification.json')
meta=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete12.tar.manifest.json')
assert proof['cases_verified']==proof['protocol_verified']==proof['physical_safe_count']==proof['all_completed_count']==12
assert not proof['original_paths_required'] and not proof['original_repository_reads'] and proof['archive_original_bytes_compared']
assert seal.sha(archive)==meta['sha256'] and meta['bytes']==archive.stat().st_size
records=seal.read(batch/'manifest.json');assert len(records)==12
out=stage/'raw_pruning';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
index=[]
for r in records:
    assert r['candidate'] in ('S','V') and r['flow'] in (1500.,1750.,2000.) and r['seed'] in (73,74) and r['scenario']=='lane_drop' and r['mode']=='transform'
    assert r['safe'] is True and r['all_completed'] is True and r['status']=='drained' and r['returncode']==0 and r['seal_status']=='verified'
    folder=Path(r['evidence_dir']);saved=seal.read(folder/'seal.json');seal.verify(folder,False)
    for name,e in saved['originals'].items():
        p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
        assert not e.get('missing') and p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']
    index.append(dict(candidate=r['candidate'],flow=r['flow'],seed=r['seed'],scenario=r['scenario'],mode=r['mode'],run_dir=r['run_dir'],evidence_dir=r['evidence_dir'],keep_full_raw=r['seed']==73,originals=saved['originals']))
assert len({(r['candidate'],r['flow'],r['seed']) for r in index})==12
seal.write(out/'raw_index_before_pruning.json',index)
mechanism=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/diagnosis/V1screen12_summary_v1/source_windows.json'
assert mechanism.is_file()
(out/'mechanism_source_windows.json').write_bytes(mechanism.read_bytes())
changes=[]
for r in index:
    if r['keep_full_raw']:
        changes.append({**r,'deleted':[],'bytes_released':0});continue
    result=seal.prune_raw(Path(r['run_dir']),batch,r['originals'],verified=True)
    assert set(result['deleted'])==set(seal.RAW_FILES)
    seal.verify(Path(r['evidence_dir']),False)
    changes.append({**r,**result})
for r in index:
    for name,e in r['originals'].items():
        p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
        assert (p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']) if r['keep_full_raw'] else not p.exists()
result=dict(cases=changes,pruned_successful_cases=6,retained_full_raw_cases=6,bytes_released=sum(r['bytes_released'] for r in changes),archive_sha256=meta['sha256'],mechanism_source_windows_sha256=seal.sha(mechanism),only_exact_seed74_success_raw_pruned=True,no_recursive_delete=True,failed_cases_pruned=0,original_manifest_and_seals_unchanged=True,old_batches_untouched=True)
seal.write(out/'pruning_verification.json',result)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='cases'}))
